interpretation_update: Full supplied screenshots confirm applicability to internal Dex1-1 and positive motor direction closes. Prior positive-q opening tests produced positive estimated effort at a physically closed gripper: closing into a stop is now the leading direction hypothesis. Lowcmd sign correspondence has not been physically validated, so not yet a proven root cause. Do not reuse positive-opening or 0..5.4 range assumptions for new trials.
